quest.title: No One Fights Alone
quest.description: The six heroes have gathered, and Mavuika awakens the power of the divine throne. The horn is sounded for all Natlan to hear — the Night War is underway! A reckoning has come for the Abyss!
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x775, Mora x34075, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x6

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: The Children of Echoes' territory is secure. All monsters down.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: I'll go deal with the Abyss Tumor!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: All good here at the People of the Springs, too. We crushed it!

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Masters of the Night-Wind are also safe. Should I go support the Flower-Feather Clan?

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Things are still pretty rough over there. I'm already en route.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: No need. I just dealt with it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Already!? But you were just at the Stadium!

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Yeah, well. You have no idea how long I've been itching to bash some heads in.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh... Fair enough...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Iansan, what should we do about the Collective of Plenty? Your home's a long ways away from the stadium.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Oh, no need to worry. I just heard from Varesa, she says they're safe now.

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: Sounds like all regions are secured. The Abyss forces are weakening.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah! Their only game-plan was to outnumber us, and that ain't gonna work now that we have the Ode of Resurrection on our side!

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: Hold up... The Abyss is sending a sizeable unit towards the Stadium.

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: I guess they've realized that the Ode of Resurrection is a game changer, so now, they are going to try to destroy the sacred flame.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: We ain't gonna let them get away with that. Friends, let's gather at the stadium!

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: More Abyss Tumors have descended, all near the Stadium. Let's split up and take them out.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Oh, and we need someone to guard the main entrance.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Allow me.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Alright. This is the final battle!

talks.objective: Hold the gate! Repel the final attack!
Hold the gate! Repel the final attack!
